notes.title: Two Strikes is leaving Early Access on April 25th!
notes.notes:
[b]To our incredible community[/b]: after years of development, countless updates, and your unwavering support during Early Access, we’re beyond excited to finally share this moment with you — [b]Two Strikes officially launches on April 25[/b] across all major platforms!

[previewyoutube=Qy5mW8NGMyw;full][/previewyoutube]
And yes — [b]there’s also a physical edition for PlayStation 5[/b], arriving the same day in both North America and Europe, with [b]pre-orders available now[/b] through select retailers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30923235/e939934dbbcfcb3dc06f7e5681d439fe54331336.jpg[/img]
From the very beginning, your feedback, passion, and dedication have helped shape Two Strikes into what it is today. The full release will introduce [b]crossplay online matchmaking[/b], an expanded [b]story mode [/b]that dives into the fighters’ backstories, and all the sharp, high-stakes action you’ve come to love — where duels can end in just one or two hits. Master your timing, read your opponent, and strike with precision.

[b]The online mode includes rollback netcode — a huge win for everyone![/b]
[b]Also, with the full launch, the base price will increase to $19.99 — so make sure to grab it before April 25![/b]

Created by [b]Retro Reactor Games[/b] and published and co-developed by [b]Entalto Publishing[/b], Two Strikes brings hand-drawn 2D combat to life with a striking art style inspired by the Sengoku period of Japan. Choose from [b]eight distinct warriors[/b], each with their own unique fighting style, and test your skill in both multiplayer and single-player modes.

And for mobile players — [b]the fight is coming to Crunchyroll® Game Vault soon[/b], with full controller support and exclusive access for Crunchyroll® Premium Mega and Ultimate Fan members.

This launch is as much yours as it is ours. You’ve been here since the beginning — now it’s time to bring it all home.

🗓️ Mark your calendars: April 25
⚔️ Sharpen your skills. Challenge your rivals. Prove your worth.
📦 Physical PS5 pre-orders are open now!

Thank you for being part of this journey.
We’ll see you on the battlefield.

[b]Retro Reactor Games [/b]& [b]Entalto Publishing[/b]

notes.title: One Strike: Rise of the Dragons (DLC)
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Rise of the Dragons[/b] [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1193370/One_Strike_Rise_of_the_Dragons/]DLC[/url][/u][/b] will add [b]3 new fighters[/b] to the game, alongside 3 news stages and 3 new amazing chiptunes.[/h2]

[h2][b]New Fighters[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dragon[/b]

    Dragon is an experienced ninja that has the ability to became invisible to get close undetected and also the ability to toss shuriken at long distances, making him a tough opponent to beat. He also is very agile and can close and expand distances from his opponents.

[*] [b]Daiyu[/b]

    Coming all the way from China to prove herself in Japan, Daiyu is the master of the Hook Swords, a deadly weapon that allows her to create different range attacks and put pressure on her enemies with ease.

[*] [b]Lotus[/b]

    Also coming from the land of the dragons, Lotus is an agile all-around fighter, master of the war fans. Even though her range is short, Lotus can move in and out quickly and is fast enough to avoid enemy attacks, creating openings for her light fast attacks with her unusual weapon.
[/list]

Add these characters to you game right now!

notes.title: Oni Remodeled
notes.notes:
@here 
Version 1.2 is LIVE on Steam!
**Changelogs**
- Several changes to AIs from Oni, Soujirou, Hinode, Hangaku to make then more unpredictable.

**Oni**
- Attack remodeled: Faster and with a lower range.
- New attack added. The attack is undefensible.

**Hangaku**
- She can keep the chain spinning while dashing back and forward.
- Chain swing attack antecipation time decreased, making the attack hit fast, but, the recovery is now slower.
- Move speed increased in 66%
- Short attack speed increased in 100%.

**Soujirou**
- Attack antecipation time decreased in 16%, making it faster to land a hit.
- Move speed increased in 60%
- Dash back speed increased in 80%
- Dash back animation time decreased in 100%

notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! The game does feature full controller support as it appears in the One Strike landing page. If you having issues to get your controller working, please let me know. 

A quick fix for the issue could be: Disable PS4, Xbox, and Generic Gamepad Configuration Support settings in Steam Big Picture controller configuration settings.

notes.title: One Strike featured as one the best Steam Releases of the week!
notes.notes:
https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/11/10/best-new-steam-games-nov-2017/

"Balletic feudal Japanese fighting game, whose name derives from the fact that the first character to get hit by the other’s sword, chain, polearm or whatever dies instantly. With each match lasting just a handful of seconds, it’s equal parts guessing game – i.e. when is the other character going to lunge – and one of strict timing mastery. The death moves, a silent collapse from standing, put me in mind of the Lucy Liu battle in Kill Bill, though I suspect that was lifted from some Kurosawa film."
